title: MEIKO — A Quality Blend〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sigh...
I can't get over how good MEIKO's coffee is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She puts in a lot of time and effort is why.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true.
She's always so careful when brewing the coffee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's not that hard.
I'm just happy to hear that everyone's enjoying the brew.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
By the way, I just wanted to know.
When you think of sandwiches, what filling immediately comes to mind?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sandwich filling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why do you want to know, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, sorry for the abrupt shift.
I was actually thinking of adding more items to the cafe menu, you see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And sandwiches are the first on my list, so I wanted to know what everyone thinks is the best choice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about egg sandwiches? There's no need for much preparation so you can serve them quickly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you don't have to take that into consideration. As you can see, we have a lot of free time in this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I think BLT sandwiches might be nice. Bacon, lettuce, tomatoes, and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, BLT's usually the first one most people would think of. I don't really like it myself, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I remember now. You don't like tomatoes, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh... S-Something like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A sandwich with no tomatoes...
Maybe a fruit sandwich?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, there's that too. But since this'll be the first new addition, maybe something more mainstream like cutlet sandwiches will be better received?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't even know there were so many different types. You two sure know your sandwiches.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
D-Do we?
I was just suggesting sandwiches that I personally liked, that's all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Besides, sandwiches are easy to make because you can just put your favorite foods in between!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no! Kohane, we need to go now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...you're right!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a performance?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! We're gonna go sing our hearts out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you for the coffee, MEIKO.
Let's talk again at another time, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks for your suggestions too.
I'll take them all into consideration.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Can't wait to see the new menu!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's nice to know they're so excited to perform.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, what made you want to add more items to the menu anyway?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, the four of them found their true feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of wanting to hold the ultimate event, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. And from now on, they'll be striving to make those feelings become reality.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it won't be easy for them to reach their dream. There will be a lot of obstacles along the way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want this SEKAI to be a place where they can feel warmly welcomed. If they ever feel down, we'll fill their tummies up and give them strength to try harder again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what made me come up with the idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Sounds like something you'd come up with indeed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll help you with that new sandwich menu.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? That'll be great. Thank you, Miku!
